about: Seconds per mutation row, per harness, measured on the CI runner from the shard logs of two full runs of every harness (each harness's measured seconds over its rows, averaged). A harness split across shards also has seconds per row by label: each slice's measured seconds shared among its rows in proportion to one plus the tests each turned red, since a mutant that turns a hundred slow tests red can take a hundred times one that turns one. The plan weights shards by these so no shard nears its time limit. A harness missing here is planned at defaultSecondsPerRow, and a row missing from its harness's labels at that harness's rate; re-measure when a shard runs past fifteen minutes.
